nodes.label: Diurnal and semidiurnal forcing
nodes.rationale: Absolute-time phase and exact integration provide a strong mathematical prior; they do not validate real atmospheric tides, Hough structure, or observed pressure phase.

nodes.label: ForecastStep contract
nodes.rationale: A pure tensor step keeps time availability, file I/O, retries, and LAYA decisions outside the differentiable graph so state and parameters can be differentiated.

nodes.label: Manufactured learning and reference
nodes.rationale: A separate NumPy/SciPy DOP853 implementation checks the toy implementation independently, but does not supply an independent truth for the real atmosphere.

nodes.label: Numerical differentiation checks
nodes.rationale: Weighted-adjoint consistency is paired with independent central finite differences and Taylor checks because matching forward and reverse derivatives alone can validate the same incorrect model.

nodes.label: Toy-column equations
nodes.rationale: The imposed conservation identities are properties encoded in the toy equations, not learned discoveries or claims of global mass and energy conservation.

nodes.label: ERA5-to-D83 input gaps
nodes.rationale: Inventory completeness does not close the hourly cadence, pressure levels, omega, surface pressure, rain convention, adapter, availability, or evaluation-window requirements.

nodes.label: SQLite idempotent execution ledger
nodes.rationale: Idempotency and atomicity are scoped to a single SQLite ledger; the design does not claim distributed exactly-once behavior.

nodes.label: Content-addressed artifact store
nodes.rationale: Content hashes and no-overwrite installation detect mismatched bytes, while interrupted installation can still leave orphan files and storage is not a complete security boundary.

nodes.label: Toy-model substep integration
nodes.rationale: Smaller time steps trade compute for convergence in the manufactured split scheme; they do not automatically improve real forecast skill.

nodes.label: StreamingCAST
nodes.rationale: The repository demonstrates a pure-tensor differentiable forecasting interface and local streaming contracts. Its four-variable independent-column model is a manufactured toy, not a D83 forecast model or operational weather system.

nodes.label: Four-variable toy-column model
nodes.rationale: This scope keeps the proof small and differentiable; it does not claim global atmospheric skill, D83 behavior, or operational precipitation.

nodes.label: External NWP differentiation boundary
nodes.rationale: External models may include clipping, limiters, condensation boundaries, or discontinuous decisions, so differentiability and global error must be rechecked after integration.

nodes.label: Knowledge source authority
nodes.rationale: Original code, documents, and evidence are authoritative; wiki and graph are derived views. Graph confidence describes extracted relationships, not scientific truth.

nodes.label: Unapproved real-weather work
nodes.rationale: The preserved D83 long-rollout failure remains unresolved. Real forecasting, LAYA, B200, external NWP, and operational approval remain unrun or unapproved.

nodes.label: Review-fix validation limits
nodes.rationale: Regression and toy-model checks preserve known failures and limitations; they do not establish physical monotonicity, global stability, real-weather skill, or operational readiness.

nodes.label: Evidence interpretation limits
nodes.rationale: Numerical agreement applies to sampled paths of the discrete toy model; small fitting error is expected from recovering three parameters in a known equation and is not real-weather skill.

nodes.label: Local data processing boundary
nodes.rationale: Real data is transformed and validated by a user-side local processor. The repository neither downloads nor uploads raw data, and inspect checks contracts and selection without forecasting D83 through the toy model.

nodes.label: Verification scope boundary
nodes.rationale: Passing tests establish only the stated code and toy-model checks; they do not certify real-weather performance or long-range global stability.
